name: EU Financial Transparency System (FTS)
gives: EU budget funds committed to beneficiaries by year, country and programme

why.quote: (no terms text read: the site is a JavaScript application and its help and open-data pages did not yield a licence)
why.basis: page answered HTTP 200 but no licence, reuse or privacy text was readable; the old open-data page /budget/fts/open_data_en.htm returned 404; ec.europa.eu/robots.txt has no rule naming /budget (not read in full)

interface: Web application with a download of full datasets (CSV and XML) and, reportedly, an export per search; an API was not found. Not confirmed.
notes: Gap: terms and download interface not confirmed. Beneficiaries can include natural persons (the FTS publishes some farmer and individual payments with limits), so the same privacy rule applies: companies and public bodies only, never a natural person. A person should read the terms and the download page before any build.
